_synthetic: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Generated by tests/golden-fixtures/synthetic/generate.ts. Contains no real taxpayer data.

register.idRule: PR-L<line>, where <line> is the 1-based CSV line of the first occurrence

summaryIfDuplicatesAreNotRemoved.note: The engine has no duplicate detection: each repeated register line stays unmatched once its 2B partner is taken.

scenarioLegend.exact: Same GSTIN, type, number (case-insensitive), date, taxable and each tax head. Pass 1.
scenarioLegend.exact_split_mismatch: Register books IGST, supplier reported CGST+SGST of the same total. Tax heads differ, so MISMATCH_VALUE in pass 3 (was EXACT_MATCH before finding F2 was fixed).
scenarioLegend.exact_itc_unavailable: 2B itcavl = N. Still an exact match, but its tax goes to totalItcNotAvailable, not totalMatchedItc (finding F3, fixed).
scenarioLegend.exact_prev_period_date: Invoice dated October, reported by the supplier in November GSTR-1 and booked in November. Legitimate match.
scenarioLegend.fuzzy_number: Supplier uploaded a different spelling of the same number (delimiters, FY token, leading zeros). Pass 2.
scenarioLegend.fuzzy_rounding: Same number, 0.40 taxable or 0.50 tax difference. Pass 2 tolerance is Rs 1.00.
scenarioLegend.fuzzy_date_typo: Same number and values, register date one day off within the month. Pass 2, FUZZY_MATCH at 0.90.
scenarioLegend.fuzzy_wrong_month: Same number and values, 2B date one month earlier. Pass 2, PROBABLE_MATCH at 0.75; its tax is at risk until checked (finding F4, fixed).
scenarioLegend.collision: A/1/12 and A/11/2 both normalize loosely to A112; the strict key (segment boundaries kept) pairs each with its own 2B line (finding F5, fixed).
scenarioLegend.mismatch_value: Same number, 2B taxable is 90 percent of the register. Pass 3.
scenarioLegend.mismatch_value_variant_no: Different spelling and 90 percent value. Pass 3.
scenarioLegend.mismatch_doctype: Register INV, 2B cdnr debit note with the same number and value. MISMATCH_DOCTYPE (finding F6, fixed).
scenarioLegend.register_prev_period_late: October invoice booked in November; it sits in the October 2B, not this one.
scenarioLegend.register_next_period: December-dated invoice keyed into the November register. Set aside as out of period, tax in totalDeferredItc (finding F7, fixed).
